Omar Al-Jaabari, 13 years old, died of his wounds at Kamal Adwan Hospital. He was among the victims of the massacre at Al-Tabaeen School two days ago. Omar suffered severe burns as a result of the American missiles that produce very high temperatures, and he was not directly injured, otherwise he would have been turned into pieces and his body would have melted. 💔 💔 💔
Imagine for a moment in time that this is your child? How would you feel about the Zionists?
